english.title: Send invitation to minor to borrow money / obtain goods / services on hire / credit
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), with a view to financial gain,sent a document, to **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a minor aged **(..SPECIFY AGE..) inviting

(A)_[him]_
(B)_[her]_

to

(C)_[borrow money]_
(D)_[obtain goods on credit or hire]_
(E)_[obtain services on credit]_
(F)_[apply for information or advice on borrowing money or otherwise obtaining credit, or hiring goods]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(1) of, and Schedule 1 to, the Consumer Credit Act 1974.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Twelve months imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time Limit on Prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
